app.name: PeopleForge
app.tagline: Increment requests and group-level employee data in one place.

home.heading: Welcome
home.intro: Submit and track increment requests, and give Sirius HR a single source of truth for employee data across all entities.
home.incrementPortalBody: Create requests, evidence the eligibility criteria and follow each request to a decision.
home.groupDashboardBody: Upload entity data, review anomalies and produce monthly, quarterly and annual reports.

hero.headline: Increments and employee data,
hero.description: Increment requests and group employee data for HR teams across Sirius and its subsidiaries.
hero.oneSignInText: Your organisation account. No separate HR password.
hero.secondCheckText: You confirm a code on each sign-in.
hero.roleAccessText: Subsidiary HR sees its own entities. Sirius HR sees all of them.
hero.notice: Every sign-in, successful or not, is recorded.

reports.heading: Reports
reports.intro: Increment request reports for your subsidiary, exportable to Excel and PDF.
reports.introGroup: Increment request reports across subsidiaries, exportable to Excel and PDF.
reports.rp01Body: Every request and employee matching the filters: status, proposed and approved increments, and turnaround time (TAT).
reports.preview: Preview: the first {shown} of {total} requests. The files include them all.
reports.logged: Every download is recorded in the audit trail with your name and the filters.
reports.introExecutive: Quarterly and annual group HR reviews, as presentation-ready PDFs.
reports.groupIntro: Built from the same figures as the dashboards, in your scope. Totals only: no individual pay.

rp03.title: RP-03 · Headcount & demographics
rp03.body: Headcount, joiners and leavers, gender and age, by subsidiary, department and grade.

rp04.title: RP-04 · Compensation & increments
rp04.body: Payroll and average pay per currency, pay by grade against its band, approved increments and their cost.

rp05.title: RP-05 · Data quality & anomalies
rp05.body: Each subsidiary's upload against the month before, and every flag raised with its status and owner.

rp06.title: RP-06 · Quarterly group HR review
rp06.body: The quarter's headcount, movement, payroll and data quality across the group, for Sirius leadership.

rp07.title: RP-07 · Annual HR report
rp07.body: The year's workforce, turnover, payroll and increments across the group, for Sirius leadership and IHC.

all.title: Decide all remaining

intro.other: {count} employees are still waiting for a decision. Decide them all at once, or one by one from the list.

all.approveHint: Approves the proposed increment for each employee still waiting. To approve a different increment, decide that employee on their own.

flag_open.title: Anomaly flag still open

errors.invalid: Check the values: names and descriptions are required, days are 1 to 30, files 1 to 10 MB, thresholds up to 6 digits and 2 decimals, and at most 10 criteria.

analytics.heading: TAT and back-and-forth
